digest.component_or_area: module-level code organization and size governance
propositions: Six high-churn, high-centrality modules sit within 7 lines of or at exactly the 800-LOC hard cap, with llm/config.py having only 7 lines headroom despite 93 fan-in and 16 commits per 400, blocking ticket d23e's deprecation alias.

The decomposition strategy from ADR 0056 (extract absorbing verbs, flatten declaration tables, split colocated domains) must be applied to the next tier of files to relieve blocking work and prevent mid-flight capacity breaches.
Seam tests asserting per-file headroom targets are load-bearing ratchets replacing the declined per-function length gate, and every relieved file must ship a guard to prevent regrowth.

The extraction succeeded: llm/config.py reduced from 793 to 631 LOC and workflow_ops.py from 794 to 511 LOC; new modules gate_context.py (243 LOC) and decide_ops.py (349 LOC) both clear the 100-LOC anti-fragmentation floor.

Static assertion coverage gaps exist: plan-review step-registry membership is uncaught, uses: declarations in gates/plan-review.yaml are unchecked, and gen_env_registry is incomplete for helpers like _llm_float.
